issue: राधिका चमक रही आली: आली read as सखी in address.
कटत भव फंद । टेर सुन दीन भिखारी की: सुन read as a request to the Lord (hear); it may be the absolutive, 'hearing the poor beggar's call, (he cuts) the snares', though कटत is intransitive.
our reading: the snares of worldly existence are cut. Hear the call of a poor beggar.
alternatives: the snares of worldly existence are cut when he hears the call of a poor beggar
